name: Big and Blind Samobor 2025

venue.name: Centar za mlade Bunker
venue.details: Natjecanje će biti održano u Centru za mlade Bunker. / Competition will be held at the Youth Center Bunker.

information: (HR) Big and Blind Samobor 2025 je natjecanje na kojemu se pretežito održavaju discipline naslijepo i discipline velikih kocaka. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost, no svatko mora biti upoznat s WCA Pravilnikom. NAPOMENA - NA OVOM NATJECANJU SE NEĆE ODRŽATI KLASIČNE DISCIPLINE KAO NPR. 3X3X3 KOCKA Natjecanje je pod organizacijom Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Kotizacija pokriva trošak organizacije natjecanja. Mogući višak kotizacije ide u svrhu razvitka Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Za više informacija, proučite ostale kartice na stranici natjecanja. ---- (EN) Big and Blind Samobor 2025 is a competition which mostly holds blind and big cube events. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations. NOTE - THIS COMPETITION WILL NOT HOLD COMMON EVENTS LIKE 3X3X3 CUBE This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Association Croatia. Registration fee covers the cost of the competition organization. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia. For more information, check other tabs on the competition website.
